scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web "pnpm --dir backend dev" "pnpm --dir frontend dev"
scripts.setup: node scripts/setup.mjs && pnpm --dir backend db:generate && pnpm --dir backend db:deploy
scripts.build: pnpm --dir backend build && pnpm --dir frontend build
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src backend/src backend/test scripts frontend/vite.config.ts package.json frontend/package.json backend/package.json frontend/tsconfig.json backend/tsconfig.json pnpm-workspace.yaml README.md
